\title{Dropout as Approximate Bayesian Inference}
\author{Y. Gal \and Z. Ghahramani}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
Dropout can be interpreted as approximate variational inference.
\end{abstract}
\section{Introduction}
Uncertainty estimates are critical in high-risk deployments.
\section{Approximation}
Predictive mean with Monte Carlo dropout is
\begin{equation}
\hat{y}=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T} f^{\omega_t}(x).
\end{equation}
\section{Conclusion}
The method yields practical uncertainty with minimal overhead.
